prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: new landscape 1536x1024 recipe hero photograph for Trading Kitchen, budget-conscious home cooking.
Primary request: Create from scratch a warm, realistic, appetizing banana bread photograph with simple recipe ingredients and ordinary baking utensils, cohesive natural-color cottage-kitchen editorial food photography.
Scene: a modest well-used honey-colored wooden kitchen table beside a white-framed window. Soft warm afternoon daylight from the side, a gently blurred autumn tree visible outside, cream plaster background, an inexpensive muted blue cotton tea towel. Restrained cozy environment, food dominant.
Main subject: a homemade banana bread loaf resting on a small wooden cutting board, a generous freshly cut slice lying in the foreground with its moist fine banana crumb clearly visible. One cut end of the loaf reveals the same crumb. Loaf has a gently domed cracked top and dark golden-brown crust, slightly imperfect homemade edges. No whole banana decoration baked on top. A few natural crumbs on the board. One simple serrated bread knife lying flat beside the board, physically plausible straight blade and single wooden handle. Bread fills about two-thirds of the frame.
Supporting ingredients behind the food, smaller and secondary: three heavily brown-spotted overripe bananas, a small ceramic bowl of flour, a small bowl of brown sugar, three ordinary brown eggs in a simple shallow dish and a modest piece of butter on a small saucer. A plain wooden mixing spoon rests on the table. Do not pile unrelated props.
Natural product placement: one small orange ARM & HAMMER Pure Baking Soda box stands unobtrusively near the flour in the rear. Accurate recognizable orange-yellow cardboard packaging, red circular arm-and-hammer logo above dark-blue words "Pure Baking Soda". Box is smaller than the loaf and gently softened by depth of field but still recognizable; not an advertisement. It is baking soda, NEVER baking powder, no Magic branding.
Camera/style: photoreal editorial food photography, inviting three-quarter view slightly above the table, landscape 3:2 around1536x1024. Broad soft window light, believable shadows, true warm colors instead of monochrome or sepia, fine tactile food and wood texture. The bread should look edible and homemade, not a plastic render. Keep objects simple, separate and physically coherent. No text overlays.
Constraints: no people or hands; no nuts, walnuts, chocolate chips, icing, glaze, frosting, cream, syrup, honey, fruit garnish, berries or invented ingredients. No luxury tabletop styling, candles, ornaments or flowers. No extra loaf pan or elaborate wire rack that could distort. No watermarks, health claims or sponsorship claims. Do not make a collage.
